_meta.what: Traits are referenced passive Definitions (B.14, C, SIGNED; keyword 'trait'). Defined once, referenced by id on a figure, like a PACKET but PASSIVE — they resolve nothing and hold no runtime state (Law 5). A Trait is NOT a PACKET and NOT a size class.

traits.name: Reach
traits.note: Threatens a 1-2" band; may strike a figure moving past without base contact; a reach strike suffers no Counter (B.8).

traits.name: Mounted
traits.note: Elongated base geometry. Keeps its size class but PLOWS as one class larger on the Impact (the lance, B.4).

traits.name: Unstoppable
traits.note: Plows through bodies unchecked; only a wall stops its Push (B.4). The canonical 'monstrous' = a Large figure + this trait, NOT a fourth size class.

traits.name: Large
traits.note: Size-class marker carried as a trait for tooling; the footprint is the authority (B.1).

traits.name: Beast
traits.note: Creature-Type marker; a Beast Square tests Nerve, a Beast Circle does not (B.10, B.13).

traits.name: Fearless
traits.note: Never tests Nerve — Saruman bred the fear out / an animated construct feels none (B.10).

traits.name: Zealous
traits.note: Discipline: ignores the FIRST Steady->Shaken step from a single shock (re-reads it) (B.10).

traits.name: Leader
traits.note: Radiates Rally (6"): steps nearby allies UP the morale track on its activation. Never breaks.

traits.name: Champion
traits.note: The Banner's Champion (A.X). 3 AP, hero profile, anchors the warband's command continuity.

traits.name: Consecrated
traits.note: Sanctified war-plate: an unstoppable-lite anchor — only a wall halts its advance; never routs.

traits.name: Sacred Banner
traits.note: Carries the Order's banner: allies within 3" roll an extra Nerve die (keep best 3) and ignore the first Push each round.

traits.name: Expendable
traits.note: Cheap chaff: fragile and numerous. Its fall within 3" is a shock that tests nearby allies' Nerve (B.10).

traits.name: Flying
traits.note: Moves over walls and terrain unchecked; ignores ground obstacles and engagement when moving over them (B.14).

traits.name: Radiant
traits.note: Harmony's light: allies within 3" ignore the first Shaken step, and the bearer never routs.

traits.name: Scaled
traits.note: Thick draconic hide: shrugs the first Wound taken each round (flavour; priced as durability).

traits.name: Terror
traits.note: A monster so dreadful that Squares within 4" test Nerve when it activates — the weak break at the sight of it (B.10).

traits.name: Regenerating
traits.note: Knits its wounds: restores 1 Wound at the start of each of its activations while it still lives.

traits.name: Shield
traits.note: PROVISIONAL. Gear. As a REACTION you may consume an ACTION packet aimed at a friendly within 1" — take the hit yourself instead (your Armour saves; no Counter, you weren't the one attacked). Declare it BEFORE the packet resolves, or you miss the window. No cap — your own body is the cap. Works regardless of facing (even while Braced). A shield wall is emergent from presence + facing, not a skill.
